Class DatabaseCommandQuery

  • Object
    • EDPQueryDescriptor
      • DatabaseCommandQuery
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    EDPRequestCommandBuilder, FieldListEnabledQuery, Serializable

    public class DatabaseCommandQuery
extends EDPQueryDescriptor
    Describes a database command query, i.e. a query on all valid database commands.

    xg

      • setObject

        public DatabaseCommandQuery setObject(String object)
        Sets the object for which the valid commands shall be provided.
        Parameters:
        object - an abas-like variable reference (VP reference) value for the object, e.g. an ID String, a database number plus an ident number or a $-selection addressing exactly one object. If the object is set, values being set with setDatabase(String) or setGroup(String) are checked against the database and group of the object.
        Returns:
        this object

        public DatabaseCommandQuery setCommandStr(String commandStr)
        sets the command filter for the query. If set, only information for the particular commands will be provided.
        Parameters:
        commandStr - command string to set command filter. This string can be any string which can be used to state a database command in abas ERP, e.g. "(Release)".
        Returns:
        this object

        public DatabaseCommandQuery setForPassword(String forPassword)
        Sets the specification of the password for which the query shall be executed. The query returns data depending on this password.
        Parameters:
        forPassword - A string which identifies a password in same manner as it can be entered in a data field with type "P12:11". This might be a id string, ident number, search word or even a "$-selection".

        this object
